slides.title: Feeling fitter isn't data.
slides.body: Good sleep, a good mood and a loud playlist all feel like progress. A retest shows what changed.

slides.title: Pick one you can repeat.
slides.body: A 2km row, a 10 minute AMRAP, a heavy 5. Same movements and standards every time.

slides.title: Copy the conditions exactly.
slides.body: Same time of day, same warm-up, same damper. Change one thing and the result means less.

slides.title: Every 8 to 12 weeks.
slides.body: Sooner and you're measuring a good day. Later and you've forgotten what you did.

slides.title: Write the splits, not just the score.
slides.body: Where you broke and how it felt tells you what to train next.
